          sleep 0.5
        end

              sleep interval
              next

                timekey_wait = @buffer_config.timekey_wait

              log.error_backtrace

            end
            sleep interval
          end
        rescue => e
          # normal errors are rescued by inner begin-rescue clause.

          log.error_backtrace

        end
      end

      def flush_thread_run(state)
        flush_thread_interval = @buffer_config.flush_thread_interval

        state.next_clock = Fluent::Clock.now + flush_thread_interval

          sleep 0.5
        end

          while @output_flush_threads_running
            current_clock = Fluent::Clock.now
            next_retry_time = nil

            end

            if state.next_clock > current_clock

            elsif next_retry_time && next_retry_time > Time.now
              interval = next_retry_time.to_f - Time.now.to_f
            else
              state.mutex.unlock
              begin
                try_flush
                # next_flush_time uses flush_thread_interval or flush_thread_burst_interval (or retrying)
                interval = next_flush_time.to_f - Time.now.to_f
                # TODO: if secondary && delayed-commit, next_flush_time will be much longer than expected
                #       because @retry still exists (#commit_write is not called yet in #try_flush)

                state.next_clock = Fluent::Clock.now + interval
              ensure
                state.mutex.lock
              end
            end

            if @dequeued_chunks_mutex.synchronize{ !@dequeued_chunks.empty? && @dequeued_chunks.first.expired? }

                ensure

              end
            end

          end
        rescue => e
          # normal errors are rescued by output plugins in #try_flush

          log.error "error on output thread", error: e
          log.error_backtrace
          raise
        ensure
          state.mutex.unlock
        end
      end

      Fluent::Plugin::Buffer::STATS_KEYS.each { |key|
        BUFFER_STATS_KEYS[key] = "buffer_#{key}"
      }

          'emit_records' => @emit_records_metrics.get,
          'emit_size' => @emit_size_metrics.get,
          # Respect original name
          # https://github.com/fluent/fluentd/blob/45c7b75ba77763eaf87136864d4942c4e0c5bfcd/lib/fluent/plugin/in_monitor_agent.rb#L284

            stats[BUFFER_STATS_KEYS[k]] = v
          end
        end

        { 'output' => stats }
      end
    end
  end

      end

def update_retry_state(output, chunk_id, using_secondary, error = nil)
        plugin_log = output.log
        retry_obj = output.retry
        failed_chunk = @queue.first
        chunk_id_hex = dump_unique_id_hex((failed_chunk && failed_chunk.unique_id) || chunk_id)
        failed_metadata = failed_chunk && failed_chunk.metadata
        failed_tag = failed_metadata && failed_metadata.tag
        failed_timekey = failed_metadata && failed_metadata.timekey
        failed_state = failed_chunk && failed_chunk.state
        log_level = plugin_log.out ? plugin_log.level : nil

        unless retry_obj
          output.retry = output.retry_state
          retry_obj = output.retry
          if error
            plugin_log.warn "failed to flush the buffer.", retry_times: retry_obj.steps, next_retry_time: retry_obj.next_time.round, retry_timeout_at: retry_obj.timeout_at, chunk: chunk_id_hex, error: error, tag: failed_tag, timekey: failed_timekey, chunk_state: failed_state, log_level: log_level
            plugin_log.warn_backtrace error.backtrace
          end
          return
        end

        # retry_obj exists

        if retry_obj.limit?
          if error
            records = 0
            @queue.each do |queued_chunk|
              records += queued_chunk.size
            end
            msg = "failed to flush the buffer, and hit limit for retries. dropping all chunks in the buffer queue."
            plugin_log.error msg, retry_times: retry_obj.steps, records: records, error: error, retry_timeout_at: retry_obj.timeout_at, chunk: chunk_id_hex, tag: failed_tag, timekey: failed_timekey, chunk_state: failed_state, log_level: log_level
            plugin_log.error_backtrace error.backtrace
          end
          clear_queue!
          plugin_log.debug "buffer queue cleared"
          output.retry = nil
        else
          # Ensure that the current time is greater than or equal to retry_obj.next_time to avoid the situation when
          # retry_obj.step is called almost as many times as the number of flush threads in a short time.
          if Time.now >= retry_obj.next_time
            retry_obj.step
          else
            retry_obj.recalc_next_time # to prevent all flush threads from retrying at the same time
          end
          if error
            if using_secondary
              msg = "failed to flush the buffer with secondary output."
              plugin_log.warn msg, retry_times: retry_obj.steps, next_retry_time: retry_obj.next_time.round, retry_timeout_at: retry_obj.timeout_at, chunk: chunk_id_hex, error: error, tag: failed_tag, timekey: failed_timekey, chunk_state: failed_state, log_level: log_level
              plugin_log.warn_backtrace error.backtrace
            else
              msg = "failed to flush the buffer."
              plugin_log.warn msg, retry_times: retry_obj.steps, next_retry_time: retry_obj.next_time.round, retry_timeout_at: retry_obj.timeout_at, chunk: chunk_id_hex, error: error, tag: failed_tag, timekey: failed_timekey, chunk_state: failed_state, log_level: log_level
              plugin_log.warn_backtrace error.backtrace
            end
          end
        end
      end

      def chunk_size_over?(chunk)
        chunk.bytesize > @chunk_limit_size || (@chunk_limit_records && chunk.size > @chunk_limit_records)
      end
